body.en: A matrix is just a rectangular table of numbers — but that simple idea packs an entire system of linear equations into one object you can add, scale, and multiply. This chapter builds the algebra of \( 2\times2 \) matrices from scratch, then uses it to solve linear systems a genuinely new way, and closes with the vector tools (magnitude, dot product, angle) AIST Math 2 pairs with it.
body.ar: A المصفوفة is just a rectangular الجدول of numbers — but that simple idea packs an entire system of المعادلات الخطية into one object you can add, scale, and multiply. This chapter builds the الجبر of \( 2\times2 \) المصفوفات from scratch, then uses it to solve linear systems a genuinely new way, and closes with the المتجه tools (magnitude, dot product, الزاوية) AIST Math 2 pairs with it.

label.en: ● Definition 2.1 — Matrix, addition, and scalar multiplication
label.ar: ● تعريف 2.1 — المصفوفة, addition, and scalar multiplication

body.en:
An \( m\times n \) matrix is a rectangular array of numbers with \( m \) rows and \( n \) columns, written \( A=[a_{ij}] \) where \( a_{ij} \) is the entry in row \( i \), column \( j \). Two matrices of the same dimensions add entrywise, and a scalar \( k \) multiplies every entry:

\[ (A+B)_{ij}=a_{ij}+b_{ij}, \qquad (kA)_{ij}=k\,a_{ij}. \]
body.ar:
An \( m\times n \) matrix is a rectangular array of numbers with \( m \) rows and \( n \) columns, written \( A=[a_{ij}] \) حيث \( a_{ij} \) is the entry in row \( i \), column \( j \). Two المصفوفات of the same dimensions add entrywise, and a scalar \( k \) multiplies every entry:

\[ (A+B)_{ij}=a_{ij}+b_{ij}, \qquad (kA)_{ij}=k\,a_{ij}. \]

body.en:
Let \( A=\begin{bmatrix}3&-2\\5&1\end{bmatrix} \) and \( B=\begin{bmatrix}-4&6\\2&-3\end{bmatrix} \). Find \( A+B \) and \( 3A \).

\[ A+B=\begin{bmatrix}3+(-4)&-2+6\\5+2&1+(-3)\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-1&4\\7&-2\end{bmatrix}. \]

\[ 3A=\begin{bmatrix}9&-6\\15&3\end{bmatrix}. \]
body.ar:
الشرح الرياضي (المصفوفات والمحددات والمتجهات):

Let \( A=\begin{bmatrix}3&-2\\5&1\end{bmatrix} \) and \( B=\begin{bmatrix}-4&6\\2&-3\end{bmatrix} \). Find \( A+B \) and \( 3A \).

\[ A+B=\begin{bmatrix}3+(-4)&-2+6\\5+2&1+(-3)\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-1&4\\7&-2\end{bmatrix}. \]

\[ 3A=\begin{bmatrix}9&-6\\15&3\end{bmatrix}. \]

body.en:
If \( A \) is \( m\times n \) and \( B \) is \( n\times p \) (the inner dimensions must match), the product \( AB \) is the \( m\times p \) matrix whose \( (i,j) \) entry is the dot product of row \( i \) of \( A \) with column \( j \) of \( B \):

\[ (AB)_{ij}=\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{ik}b_{kj}. \]

Matrix multiplication is not commutative in general — \( AB\neq BA \) even when both products are defined.
body.ar:
If \( A \) is \( m\times n \) and \( B \) is \( n\times p \) (the inner dimensions must match), the product \( AB \) is the \( m\times p \) المصفوفة whose \( (i,j) \) entry is the dot product of row \( i \) of \( A \) with column \( j \) of \( B \):

\[ (AB)_{ij}=\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{ik}b_{kj}. \]

Matrix multiplication is not commutative in general — \( AB\neq BA \) even عندما both products are defined.

label.en: Worked example 2.B — Multiply two matrices, and a matrix by a vector
label.ar: مثال محلول 2.B — Multiply two المصفوفات, and a المصفوفة by a المتجه

body.ar:
الشرح الرياضي (المصفوفات والمحددات والمتجهات):

Let \( A=\begin{bmatrix}2&1\\0&3\end{bmatrix} \), \( B=\begin{bmatrix}4&-1\\2&5\end{bmatrix} \), and \( \mathbf{v}=\begin{bmatrix}5\\-2\end{bmatrix} \).

\[ AB=\begin{bmatrix}(2)(4)+(1)(2)&(2)(-1)+(1)(5)\\(0)(4)+(3)(2)&(0)(-1)+(3)(5)\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}10&3\\6&15\end{bmatrix}. \]

\[ A\mathbf{v}=\begin{bmatrix}(2)(5)+(1)(-2)\\(0)(5)+(3)(-2)\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}8\\-6\end{bmatrix}. \]

label.en: ● Definition 2.3 — Determinant and the identity matrix
label.ar: ● تعريف 2.3 — المحدد and the المتطابقة المصفوفة

body.en: For a \( 2\times2 \) matrix \( A=\begin{bmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{bmatrix} \), the determinant is the scalar \[ \det A=ad-bc. \] The \( 2\times2 \) identity matrix \( I=\begin{bmatrix}1&0\\0&1\end{bmatrix} \) satisfies \( IA=AI=A \) for every \( 2\times2 \) matrix \( A \) — it's the multiplicative identity.
body.ar: For a \( 2\times2 \) المصفوفة \( A=\begin{bmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{bmatrix} \), the determinant is the scalar \[ \det A=ad-bc. \] The \( 2\times2 \) identity matrix \( I=\begin{bmatrix}1&0\\0&1\end{bmatrix} \) satisfies \( IA=AI=A \) for every \( 2\times2 \) المصفوفة \( A \) — it's the multiplicative المتطابقة.

body.en:
If \( A=\begin{bmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{bmatrix} \) and \( \det A=ad-bc\neq0 \), then \( A \) is invertible, with

\[ A^{-1}=\frac{1}{\det A}\begin{bmatrix}d&-b\\-c&a\end{bmatrix}. \]

If \( \det A=0 \), no inverse exists.
body.ar:
الشرح الرياضي (المصفوفات والمحددات والمتجهات):

If \( A=\begin{bmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{bmatrix} \) and \( \det A=ad-bc\neq0 \), then \( A \) is invertible, with

\[ A^{-1}=\frac{1}{\det A}\begin{bmatrix}d&-b\\-c&a\end{bmatrix}. \]

If \( \det A=0 \), no inverse exists.

body.en:
Let \( A=\begin{bmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{bmatrix} \) and \( d_0=ad-bc\neq0 \). Multiply \( A \) by the claimed inverse \( \tfrac{1}{d_0}\begin{bmatrix}d&-b\\-c&a\end{bmatrix} \) (Definition 2.2):

\[ A\cdot\frac{1}{d_0}\begin{bmatrix}d&-b\\-c&a\end{bmatrix}=\frac{1}{d_0}\begin{bmatrix}ad-bc&-ab+ba\\cd-dc&-cb+da\end{bmatrix}=\frac{1}{d_0}\begin{bmatrix}d_0&0\\0&d_0\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}1&0\\0&1\end{bmatrix}=I. \]

The same computation in the other order gives \( \tfrac{1}{d_0}\begin{bmatrix}d&-b\\-c&a\end{bmatrix}\cdot A=I \) as well, so this matrix is a genuine two-sided inverse. When \( \det A=0 \), suppose toward contradiction some matrix \( B \) satisfied \( AB=I \); a short computation (or the fact that \( \det(AB)=\det A\cdot\det B \)) would force \( \det A\cdot\det B=\det I=1 \), impossible since \( \det A=0 \) makes the left side \( 0 \). So no inverse exists. \( \blacksquare \)
body.ar:
Let \( A=\begin{bmatrix}a&b\\c&d\end{bmatrix} \) and \( d_0=ad-bc\neq0 \). Multiply \( A \) by the claimed inverse \( \tfrac{1}{d_0}\begin{bmatrix}d&-b\\-c&a\end{bmatrix} \) (تعريف 2.2):

\[ A\cdot\frac{1}{d_0}\begin{bmatrix}d&-b\\-c&a\end{bmatrix}=\frac{1}{d_0}\begin{bmatrix}ad-bc&-ab+ba\\cd-dc&-cb+da\end{bmatrix}=\frac{1}{d_0}\begin{bmatrix}d_0&0\\0&d_0\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}1&0\\0&1\end{bmatrix}=I. \]

The same computation in the other order gives \( \tfrac{1}{d_0}\begin{bmatrix}d&-b\\-c&a\end{bmatrix}\cdot A=I \) as well, so this المصفوفة is a genuine two-sided inverse. عندما \( \det A=0 \), suppose toward contradiction some المصفوفة \( B \) satisfied \( AB=I \); a short computation (or the fact that \( \det(AB)=\det A\cdot\det B \)) would force \( \det A\cdot\det B=\det I=1 \), impossible since \( \det A=0 \) makes the left side \( 0 \). So no inverse exists. \( \blacksquare \)

label.en: Worked example 2.C — Invert a matrix and solve a system with it
label.ar: مثال محلول 2.C — Invert a المصفوفة and solve a system with it

body.en:
Solve \( \begin{cases}2x+3y=16\\x-y=-2\end{cases} \) by writing it as \( A\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{b} \) and inverting \( A \).

Here \( A=\begin{bmatrix}2&3\\1&-1\end{bmatrix} \), \( \mathbf{b}=\begin{bmatrix}16\\-2\end{bmatrix} \). \( \det A=(2)(-1)-(3)(1)=-5 \), so by Theorem 2.1:

\[ A^{-1}=\frac{1}{-5}\begin{bmatrix}-1&-3\\-1&2\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}\tfrac{1}{5}&\tfrac{3}{5}\\[2pt]\tfrac{1}{5}&-\tfrac{2}{5}\end{bmatrix}. \]

Then \( \mathbf{x}=A^{-1}\mathbf{b} \): \[ x=\tfrac{1}{5}(16)+\tfrac{3}{5}(-2)=\tfrac{16-6}{5}=2, \qquad y=\tfrac{1}{5}(16)+\left(-\tfrac{2}{5}\right)(-2)=\tfrac{16+4}{5}=4. \] Check: \( 2(2)+3(4)=4+12=16 \) ✓ and \( 2-4=-2 \) ✓.
body.ar:
Solve \( \begin{cases}2x+3y=16\\x-y=-2\end{cases} \) by writing it as \( A\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{b} \) and inverting \( A \).

Here \( A=\begin{bmatrix}2&3\\1&-1\end{bmatrix} \), \( \mathbf{b}=\begin{bmatrix}16\\-2\end{bmatrix} \). \( \det A=(2)(-1)-(3)(1)=-5 \), so by مبرهنة 2.1:

\[ A^{-1}=\frac{1}{-5}\begin{bmatrix}-1&-3\\-1&2\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}\tfrac{1}{5}&\tfrac{3}{5}\\[2pt]\tfrac{1}{5}&-\tfrac{2}{5}\end{bmatrix}. \]

Then \( \mathbf{x}=A^{-1}\mathbf{b} \): \[ x=\tfrac{1}{5}(16)+\tfrac{3}{5}(-2)=\tfrac{16-6}{5}=2, \qquad y=\tfrac{1}{5}(16)+\left(-\tfrac{2}{5}\right)(-2)=\tfrac{16+4}{5}=4. \] Check: \( 2(2)+3(4)=4+12=16 \) ✓ and \( 2-4=-2 \) ✓.

label.en: ● Definition 2.4 — Vectors: magnitude and dot product
label.ar: ● تعريف 2.4 — المتجهات: magnitude and dot product

body.en: A vector \( \mathbf{u}=\langle u_1,u_2\rangle \) in the plane has magnitude \( |\mathbf{u}|=\sqrt{u_1^2+u_2^2} \). The dot product of \( \mathbf{u}=\langle u_1,u_2\rangle \) and \( \mathbf{v}=\langle v_1,v_2\rangle \) is the scalar \[ \mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}=u_1v_1+u_2v_2. \]
body.ar: A المتجه \( \mathbf{u}=\langle u_1,u_2\rangle \) in the plane has magnitude \( |\mathbf{u}|=\sqrt{u_1^2+u_2^2} \). The dot product of \( \mathbf{u}=\langle u_1,u_2\rangle \) and \( \mathbf{v}=\langle v_1,v_2\rangle \) is the scalar \[ \mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}=u_1v_1+u_2v_2. \]

body.en: For nonzero vectors \( \mathbf{u},\mathbf{v} \) with angle \( \theta \) between them, \[ \cos\theta=\frac{\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}}{|\mathbf{u}|\,|\mathbf{v}|}. \]
body.ar: For nonzero المتجهات \( \mathbf{u},\mathbf{v} \) with الزاوية \( \theta \) between them, \[ \cos\theta=\frac{\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}}{|\mathbf{u}|\,|\mathbf{v}|}. \]

body.en: Place \( \mathbf{u} \) and \( \mathbf{v} \) tail-to-tail; the vector from the tip of \( \mathbf{u} \) to the tip of \( \mathbf{v} \) is \( \mathbf{v}-\mathbf{u} \), and the three sides \( |\mathbf{u}|,|\mathbf{v}|,|\mathbf{v}-\mathbf{u}| \) form a triangle with included angle \( \theta \) at the shared tail. The Law of Cosines gives \[ |\mathbf{v}-\mathbf{u}|^2=|\mathbf{u}|^2+|\mathbf{v}|^2-2|\mathbf{u}||\mathbf{v}|\cos\theta. \] Expand the left side using \( |\mathbf{v}-\mathbf{u}|^2=(\mathbf{v}-\mathbf{u})\cdot(\mathbf{v}-\mathbf{u})=|\mathbf{v}|^2-2\,\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}+|\mathbf{u}|^2 \) (dot product distributes like ordinary multiplication). Setting the two expressions for \( |\mathbf{v}-\mathbf{u}|^2 \) equal and cancelling \( |\mathbf{u}|^2+|\mathbf{v}|^2 \) from both sides leaves \( -2\,\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}=-2|\mathbf{u}||\mathbf{v}|\cos\theta \), i.e. \( \cos\theta=\dfrac{\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}}{|\mathbf{u}||\mathbf{v}|} \). \( \blacksquare \)
body.ar: Place \( \mathbf{u} \) and \( \mathbf{v} \) tail-to-tail; the المتجه from the tip of \( \mathbf{u} \) to the tip of \( \mathbf{v} \) is \( \mathbf{v}-\mathbf{u} \), and the three sides \( |\mathbf{u}|,|\mathbf{v}|,|\mathbf{v}-\mathbf{u}| \) form a المثلث with included الزاوية \( \theta \) at the shared tail. The Law of Cosines gives \[ |\mathbf{v}-\mathbf{u}|^2=|\mathbf{u}|^2+|\mathbf{v}|^2-2|\mathbf{u}||\mathbf{v}|\cos\theta. \] Expand the left side using \( |\mathbf{v}-\mathbf{u}|^2=(\mathbf{v}-\mathbf{u})\cdot(\mathbf{v}-\mathbf{u})=|\mathbf{v}|^2-2\,\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}+|\mathbf{u}|^2 \) (dot product distributes like ordinary multiplication). Setting the two expressions for \( |\mathbf{v}-\mathbf{u}|^2 \) equal and cancelling \( |\mathbf{u}|^2+|\mathbf{v}|^2 \) from both sides leaves \( -2\,\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}=-2|\mathbf{u}||\mathbf{v}|\cos\theta \), i.e. \( \cos\theta=\dfrac{\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}}{|\mathbf{u}||\mathbf{v}|} \). \( \blacksquare \)

body.en:
Matrix Multiplication is Non-Commutative: In general, \(AB \neq BA\). For dimensions \(m \times n\) and \(n \times p\), the inner dimensions must match to multiply. Swapping them may not even be defined.

Inverse Invertibility Condition: A matrix \(A = \begin{pmatrix}a & b\\ c & d\end{pmatrix}\) is invertible if and only if \(\det(A) = ad - bc \neq 0\). If \(\det(A) = 0\), the system has either no unique solution or infinitely many solutions.

Dot Product vs Vector: The dot product \(\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}\) is a scalar (a single real number), not a vector. The vectors are orthogonal if and only if \(\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v} = 0\).

question.en: Let \( A = \begin{pmatrix} 3 & 1 \\ 5 & 2 \end{pmatrix} \). Find \( A^{-1} \) and use it to solve the linear system: \[ 3x + y = 7 \] \[ 5x + 2y = 12 \]
question.ar: ليكن \( A = \begin{pmatrix} 3 & 1 \\ 5 & 2 \end{pmatrix} \). أوجد \( A^{-1} \) and use it to حل the linear system: \[ 3x + y = 7 \] \[ 5x + 2y = 12 \]

solution.en:
Step 1: Compute the determinant of \( A \):
\[ \det(A) = ad - bc = (3)(2) - (1)(5) = 6 - 5 = 1. \]

Step 2: Construct the inverse \( A^{-1} \):
Swap the main diagonal entries, negate the off-diagonal entries, and divide by \( \det(A) = 1 \):
\[ A^{-1} = \frac{1}{1} \begin{pmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ -5 & 3 \end{pmatrix} = \mathbf{\begin{pmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ -5 & 3 \end{pmatrix}}. \]

Step 3: Solve the matrix equation \( A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b} \):
\[ \begin{pmatrix} x \\ y \end{pmatrix} = A^{-1}\mathbf{b} = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ -5 & 3 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} 7 \\ 12 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 2(7) + (-1)(12) \\ -5(7) + 3(12) \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 14 - 12 \\ -35 + 36 \end{pmatrix} = \mathbf{\begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix}}. \]

Thus \( \mathbf{x = 2} \) and \( \mathbf{y = 1} \). (Check: \( 3(2) + 1 = 7 \) ✓ and \( 5(2) + 2(1) = 12 \) ✓).

question.en:
Given 3D vectors \( \mathbf{u} = \langle 2, -3, 6 \rangle \) and \( \mathbf{v} = \langle 1, 4, 2 \rangle \):
(a) Find the unit vector in the direction of \( \mathbf{u} \).
(b) Calculate the angle \( \theta \) between \( \mathbf{u} \) and \( \mathbf{v} \) to the nearest degree.
question.ar:
Given 3D vectors \( \mathbf{u} = \langle 2, -3, 6 \rangle \) and \( \mathbf{v} = \langle 1, 4, 2 \rangle \):
(a) أوجد unit vector in the direction of \( \mathbf{u} \).
(b) احسب angle \( \theta \) between \( \mathbf{u} \) and \( \mathbf{v} \) مقرباً إلى أقرب degree.

solution.en:
Part (a): Find the unit vector \( \hat{\mathbf{u}} \):
1. Magnitude of \( \mathbf{u} \): \[ |\mathbf{u}| = \sqrt{2^2 + (-3)^2 + 6^2} = \sqrt{4 + 9 + 36} = \sqrt{49} = 7. \]
2. Unit vector: \[ \hat{\mathbf{u}} = \frac{\mathbf{u}}{|\mathbf{u}|} = \mathbf{\left\langle \frac{2}{7}, -\frac{3}{7}, \frac{6}{7} \right\rangle}. \]

Part (b): Find the angle \( \theta \):
1. Dot product \( \mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v} \): \[ \mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v} = (2)(1) + (-3)(4) + (6)(2) = 2 - 12 + 12 = 2. \]
2. Magnitude of \( \mathbf{v} \): \[ |\mathbf{v}| = \sqrt{1^2 + 4^2 + 2^2} = \sqrt{1 + 16 + 4} = \sqrt{21}. \]
3. Angle \( \theta \): \[ \cos\theta = \frac{\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}}{|\mathbf{u}||\mathbf{v}|} = \frac{2}{7\sqrt{21}} \approx \frac{2}{32.078} \approx 0.06235. \]
\[ \theta = \cos^{-1}(0.06235) \approx \mathbf{86^\circ}. \]

question.en: Find all real values of the constant \( k \) for which the matrix \( M = \begin{pmatrix} k+2 & 4 \\ 3 & k-2 \end{pmatrix} \) is singular (has no inverse).
question.ar: أوجد all real values of the constant \( k \) for which the matrix \( M = \begin{pmatrix} k+2 & 4 \\ 3 & k-2 \end{pmatrix} \) is singular (has no inverse).

solution.en:
Step 1: Set the determinant to zero:
A matrix is singular if and only if \( \det(M) = 0 \):
\[ \det(M) = (k+2)(k-2) - (4)(3) = 0. \]

Step 2: Solve the algebraic equation:
\[ (k^2 - 4) - 12 = 0 \implies k^2 - 16 = 0. \]

Step 3: Extract roots:
\[ (k - 4)(k + 4) = 0 \implies \mathbf{k = 4 \quad\text{or}\quad k = -4}. \]

Check: For \( k = 4 \), \( M = \begin{pmatrix} 6 & 4 \\ 3 & 2 \end{pmatrix} \), \( \det = 12 - 12 = 0 \) ✓.
For \( k = -4 \), \( M = \begin{pmatrix} -2 & 4 \\ 3 & -6 \end{pmatrix} \), \( \det = 12 - 12 = 0 \) ✓.

question.en: Vectors \( \mathbf{a} = \langle 4, k \rangle \) and \( \mathbf{b} = \langle 6, -8 \rangle \) are perpendicular. Find the value of \( k \), and compute the projection of \( \mathbf{c} = \langle 10, 5 \rangle \) onto \( \mathbf{b} \).
question.ar: Vectors \( \mathbf{a} = \langle 4, k \rangle \) and \( \mathbf{b} = \langle 6, -8 \rangle \) are perpendicular. أوجد قيمة \( k \), and compute the projection of \( \mathbf{c} = \langle 10, 5 \rangle \) onto \( \mathbf{b} \).

solution.en:
Step 1: Use the orthogonality condition \( \mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b} = 0 \):
\[ \mathbf{a}\cdot\mathbf{b} = (4)(6) + (k)(-8) = 24 - 8k = 0 \implies 8k = 24 \implies \mathbf{k = 3}. \]

Step 2: Compute the vector projection of \( \mathbf{c} \) onto \( \mathbf{b} \):
The scalar projection is \( \operatorname{comp}_{\mathbf{b}}\mathbf{c} = \frac{\mathbf{c}\cdot\mathbf{b}}{|\mathbf{b}|} \).
1. \( \mathbf{c}\cdot\mathbf{b} = (10)(6) + (5)(-8) = 60 - 40 = 20 \).
2. \( |\mathbf{b}| = \sqrt{6^2 + (-8)^2} = \sqrt{36 + 64} = \sqrt{100} = 10 \).
3. Vector projection: \[ \operatorname{proj}_{\mathbf{b}}\mathbf{c} = \left(\frac{\mathbf{c}\cdot\mathbf{b}}{|\mathbf{b}|^2}\right)\mathbf{b} = \left(\frac{20}{100}\right)\langle 6, -8 \rangle = \frac{1}{5}\langle 6, -8 \rangle = \mathbf{\left\langle \frac{6}{5}, -\frac{8}{5} \right\rangle}. \]

question.en: Given the vectors \( \mathbf{u} = \langle 3, -4 \rangle \) and \( \mathbf{v} = \langle -2, 5 \rangle \), what is the vector \( 2\mathbf{u} + \mathbf{v} \)?
question.ar: حل المسألة التالية في (Matrices & Vectors): Given the vectors \( \mathbf{u} = \langle 3, -4 \rangle \) and \( \mathbf{v} = \langle -2, 5 \rangle \), what is the vector \( 2\mathbf{u} + \mathbf{v} \)?

hints.en: To find \( 2\mathbf{u} + \mathbf{v} \), first perform the scalar multiplication on \( \mathbf{u} \): \(2\mathbf{u} = 2\langle 3, -4 \rangle = \langle 2(3), 2(-4) \rangle = \langle 6, -8 \rangle\).
hints.ar: To أوجد \( 2\mathbf{u} + \mathbf{v} \), first perform the scalar multiplication on \( \mathbf{u} \): \(2\mathbf{u} = 2\langle 3, -4 \rangle = \langle 2(3), 2(-4) \rangle = \langle 6, -8 \rangle\).

hints.en: Next, add the corresponding components of \( 2\mathbf{u} \) and \( \mathbf{v} \): \(2u + v\). Rewrite and substitute: \(2u + v = \langle 6 + (-2), -8 + 5 \rangle\).
hints.ar: Next, add the corresponding components of \( 2\mathbf{u} \) and \( \mathbf{v} \): \(2u + v\). Rewrite and عوّض: \(2u + v = \langle 6 + (-2), -8 + 5 \rangle\).

hints.en: Evaluate \(\langle 6 + (-2), -8 + 5 \rangle\) to obtain the final answer.
hints.ar: احسب قيمة \(\langle 6 + (-2), -8 + 5 \rangle\) to obtain the final answer.

solution.en:
To find \( 2\mathbf{u} + \mathbf{v} \), first perform the scalar multiplication on \( \mathbf{u} \):
\[
2\mathbf{u} = 2\langle 3, -4 \rangle = \langle 2(3), 2(-4) \rangle = \langle 6, -8 \rangle
\]
Next, add the corresponding components of \( 2\mathbf{u} \) and \( \mathbf{v} \):
\[
2\mathbf{u} + \mathbf{v} = \langle 6 + (-2), -8 + 5 \rangle = \langle 4, -3 \rangle
\]

- \( \langle 1, 1 \rangle \) is incorrect because it represents \( \mathbf{u} + \mathbf{v} \), omitting the scalar factor of 2.
- \( \langle 4, 1 \rangle \) is incorrect because the scalar 2 was only distributed to the horizontal component.
- \( \langle 8, -13 \rangle \) is incorrect because it calculates \( 2\mathbf{u} - \mathbf{v} \) instead of \( 2\mathbf{u} + \mathbf{v} \).
